title: VCP Context Schema v3.2
description: JSON Schema for VCP/A Adaptation Layer context validation. 14 baseline dimensions in VCP v3.1 (9 situational, positions 1-9, and 5 personal-state dimensions on the R-line with optional 1-5 intensity), plus 4 experimental VEP-0004 situational dimensions (positions 10-13, a v3.2 candidate not yet accepted, gated behind the vcp-a-ext-v1 capability token), 18 with them. The ‖ (U+2016 DOUBLE VERTICAL LINE) separator divides the situational and personal bands in the wire format.

context.description: Wire-format context string. Situational band uses pipe-separated symbol+value groups; personal band (if present) is introduced by ‖ and contains pipe-separated symbol+value[:intensity] groups.

situational.description: Situational dimensions: positions 1-9 (v3.1 baseline) and the experimental VEP-0004 positions 10-13.

conformance_level.description: Minimal=9 situational only; Standard=9 situational + 5 personal; Extended=adds any VEP-0004 dim (positions 10-13).

has_emergency.description: Emergency indicators present (e.g., OCCASION=🚨 or EMBODIMENT=🛑).

dimension_values.description: Emoji values for a situational dimension.

dimension_symbol.description: Situational dimension identifier emoji (13 dims in VCP v3.2).

time_values.description: TIME ⏰ (position 1). Values per VCP/A §2.2: 🌅 morning, ☀️ daytime, 🌆 evening, 🌙 night, 📅 weekday, 🎉 weekend, ⏰ time_pressure, 📆 scheduled, 🔄 recurring. This enum is the canonical vocabulary; parsed.situational arrays use dimension_values and do not restrict values to it.

space_values.description: SPACE 📍 (position 2). Values per VCP/A §2.2: 🏡 home, 🏢 office, 🏫 school, 🏥 hospital, ⛪ religious, 🏛️ government, 🏪 commercial, 🚗 vehicle, 🌳 outdoor, 💻 digital, 🏠 shared_space, 🔒 secure_facility. This enum is the canonical vocabulary; parsed.situational arrays use dimension_values and do not restrict values to it.

company_values.description: COMPANY 👥 (position 3). Values per VCP/A §2.2: 👤 alone, 👶 children, 👨‍👩‍👧 family, 👔 colleagues, 👨‍🏫 teacher, 👮 authority, 👴 elders, 💑 partner, 🤝 peers, 👨‍⚕️ professional, 🧑‍🤝‍🧑 strangers, 👥 crowd, 🐕 pets. This enum is the canonical vocabulary; parsed.situational arrays use dimension_values and do not restrict values to it.

culture_values.description: CULTURE 🌍 (position 4). Values per VCP/A §2.2: Communication styles, NOT nationalities. 🔇 high_context, 📢 low_context, 🎩 formal, 👋 informal, 📊 hierarchical, ⚖️ egalitarian, 👥 collectivist, 👤 individualist. This enum is the canonical vocabulary; parsed.situational arrays use dimension_values and do not restrict values to it.

occasion_values.description: OCCASION 🎭 (position 5). Values per VCP/A §2.2: ➖ normal, 🎂 celebration, 💼 business, ⚰️ mourning, 💒 ceremony, 🏥 medical, 🚨 emergency, 👨‍🏫 educational, 🎪 entertainment, ⚖️ legal, 🗳️ political, 🎓 graduation. This enum is the canonical vocabulary; parsed.situational arrays use dimension_values and do not restrict values to it.

environment_values.description: ENVIRONMENT 🌡️ (position 6). Values per VCP/A §2.2: 🥵 hot, 🥶 cold, 🌧️ wet, 🌪️ dangerous, 🔇 quiet, 📢 loud, 🔥 fire, 💨 windy, 🌫️ poor_visibility, 🌤️ outdoors, 🏔️ high_altitude, 🌊 near_water. This enum is the canonical vocabulary; parsed.situational arrays use dimension_values and do not restrict values to it.

agency_values.description: AGENCY 🔷 (position 7). Values per VCP/A §2.2: 👑 leader, 🤝 peer, 👇 subordinate, 💰 wealthy, 💵 adequate, 🕳️ scarce, 🏡 owner, 🔑 authorized, 🎓 expert, 🆓 autonomous, 🔐 limited, 🏃 mobile. This enum is the canonical vocabulary; parsed.situational arrays use dimension_values and do not restrict values to it.

constraints_values.description: CONSTRAINTS 🔶 (position 8). Values per VCP/A §2.2: ○ minimal, 🚧 physical, ⚖️ legal, 💸 economic, ⏰ time, 🤐 social, 📱 surveillance, 🚨 emergency, 👮 enforcement, 📜 contractual, 🏥 medical, 🔒 confidential. This enum is the canonical vocabulary; parsed.situational arrays use dimension_values and do not restrict values to it.

system_context_values.description: SYSTEM_CONTEXT 📡 (position 9). Values per VCP/A §2.2: 💻 personal_device, 🏢 workplace_system, 🖥️ shared_terminal, 👁️ monitored_environment. This enum is the canonical vocabulary; parsed.situational arrays use dimension_values and do not restrict values to it.

embodiment_values.description: EMBODIMENT 🧍 (position 10, VEP-0004, Experimental). Values per VCP/A §2.2: 🪑 stationary, 🚶 navigating, ✋ manipulating, 📦 carrying, 🛑 emergency_stop. This enum is the canonical vocabulary; parsed.situational arrays use dimension_values and do not restrict values to it.

proximity_values.description: PROXIMITY ↔️ (position 11, VEP-0004, Experimental). Values per VCP/A §2.2: 🌐 distant, 🏠 same_room, 👣 nearby, 🤏 close, 👆 contact. This enum is the canonical vocabulary; parsed.situational arrays use dimension_values and do not restrict values to it.

formality_values.description: FORMALITY 🎩 (position 13, VEP-0004, Experimental). Values per VCP/A §2.2: 😎 casual, 💼 professional, 🎓 formal, 🏛️ ceremonial. This enum is the canonical vocabulary; parsed.situational arrays use dimension_values and do not restrict values to it.

cognitive_state_values.description: COGNITIVE_STATE 🧠 (personal position 1). Canonical categories per VCP/A §2.1 and §3.1 and VCP-X-Personal §2: focused, distracted, overloaded, foggy, reflective. This enum is the canonical vocabulary; personal_state_value.value accepts any lowercase category so that receivers stay forward compatible (VCP/A §2.3).

emotional_tone_values.description: EMOTIONAL_TONE 💭 (personal position 2). Canonical categories per VCP/A §2.1 and §3.1 and VCP-X-Personal §2: calm, tense, frustrated, neutral, uplifted. This enum is the canonical vocabulary; personal_state_value.value accepts any lowercase category so that receivers stay forward compatible (VCP/A §2.3).

energy_level_values.description: ENERGY_LEVEL 🔋 (personal position 3). Canonical categories per VCP/A §2.1 and §3.1 and VCP-X-Personal §2: rested, low_energy, fatigued, wired, depleted. This enum is the canonical vocabulary; personal_state_value.value accepts any lowercase category so that receivers stay forward compatible (VCP/A §2.3).

perceived_urgency_values.description: PERCEIVED_URGENCY ⚡ (personal position 4). Canonical categories per VCP/A §2.1 and §3.1 and VCP-X-Personal §2: unhurried, time_aware, pressured, critical. This enum is the canonical vocabulary; personal_state_value.value accepts any lowercase category so that receivers stay forward compatible (VCP/A §2.3).

body_signals_values.description: BODY_SIGNALS 🩺 (personal position 5). Canonical categories per VCP/A §2.1 and §3.1 and VCP-X-Personal §2: neutral, discomfort, pain, unwell, recovering. This enum is the canonical vocabulary; personal_state_value.value accepts any lowercase category so that receivers stay forward compatible (VCP/A §2.3).
